items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Then he cut it down to four, Panama, drums, Dave Rivera, piano, Milt Hinton, bass, and myself.

ctx.x: Then he cut it down to four, Panama, drums, Dave Rivera, piano, Milt Hinton, bass, and myself. One horn. And he had to have the trumpet to growl on 'Minnie the Moocher.'
